ICS 13.060.50CHD 36Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard prescribes three different methods for the determination of boron:a) Curcumin method from 0.10 mg/l to 1.0 mg/l;b) Carmine method from 1.0 mg/l to 10 mg/l; andc) Induced coupled plasma method.2.
